promptEs: ¿Qué intervalo hay entre La4 y Fa5?
promptEn: What interval is there between A4 and F5?
explanationEs: De La a Fa hay seis letras y ocho semitonos: una sexta menor. Es menor porque la sexta justa tiene siete semitonos y falta uno.
explanationEn: From A to F there are six letters and eight semitones: a minor sixth. It is minor because a perfect sixth has seven semitones and one is missing.
